summary.ja_easy: {電気|でんき}の{会社|かいしゃ}は、{家|いえ}によって{違|ちが}います。{入|はい}る{前|まえ}に、{会社|かいしゃ}が{決|き}まっているか、{不動産|ふどうさん}の{会社|かいしゃ}に{聞|き}きます。{申|もう}し{込|こ}みは、{電気|でんき}の{会社|かいしゃ}の{方法|ほうほう}でします（ウェブや{電話|でんわ}など）。{使|つか}い{始|はじ}める{日|ひ}と{申|もう}し{込|こ}みの{方法|ほうほう}を、{早|はや}めに{調|しら}べます。はがきで{申|もう}し{込|こ}む{家|いえ}もあります（{一|ひと}つの{例|れい}です）。{出|で}るときは、やめる{日|ひ}を{電気|でんき}の{会社|かいしゃ}に{知|し}らせます（{要|よう}{確認|かくにん}）。
summary.en: Who supplies electricity depends on the home and the contract. Before moving in, ask the real estate agent whether the property uses a set power company. Apply following the instructions of the company you contract with (for example online or by phone; methods differ by company). Check the start date and how to apply early. Some properties have an application postcard, for example on the breaker (this is one example). When you move out, tell the company you contract with the day you stop (to be checked).

lead.en: Apply to the power company you contract with, in the way that company sets. Ask the real estate agent whether the property uses a set company.
